  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwner

ensurePostcodeValidForCity:

  next: ensureRegistrationDateNotFuture

ensureRegistrationDateNotFuture:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureRegistrationDateNotFuture
  next: resolveRegistrationDate

resolveRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveRegistrationDate
  next: normalizeAddress

normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity

  next: countDailyRegistrations

  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountDailyRegistrations
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyRegistrationLimit

ensureDailyRegistrationLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyRegistrationLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold

assignMembershipNumber:

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

assignBulkSignupWarning:

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:

  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits; the result must have 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. The E.164 string (e.g. '+61412345678') is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The effective date must fall on a business day: if it lands on
            a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the following Monday, and
            that adjusted date is what is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the owner's ageBand,
            computed against the effective registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW
            2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall
            within that region's inclusive range. A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only opt-in flag for create. When true it allows creating an
            owner that shares a household (same lastName and address, compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) with an existing owner;
            otherwise such a create is rejected 409. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city,
                LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN
                is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create
                (one more than the number of owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode, derived on read.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who live in the same
                household (same lastName and address, compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace). Assigned on create when the request
                sets sharesHousehold true: all owners sharing the household
                receive the same value. Null for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'e6b1c2d4-0f3a-4b8c-9d2e-1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, the single value all duplicate
                detection is expressed through:
                normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId,
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 form, the email is
                lower-cased (empty when absent) and the householdId is empty when
                the owner is not in a shared household. A create is rejected 409
                only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at
                create time. It starts at 1, gains 1 when an email is present
                and 1 more when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is
                reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived on read from the city using a
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived when a birthDate is supplied by
                computing the completed years from birthDate to the effective
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was given.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the soft-match "possible duplicate" rule for `POST /api/owners`.

**Behavior:** When a new owner isn't a hard duplicate (its full `identityKey` doesn't clash) but shares an existing owner's `lastName` (case-insensitive) and `postcode` with a *different* telephone, the owner is still created and returns `possibleDuplicate: true` with `possibleDuplicateOf` set to the matching owner's id (the earliest match, for determinism). Otherwise `possibleDuplicate: false` and `possibleDuplicateOf: null`.

**Changes:**

1. **New function** `AssignPossibleDuplicate.java` — computes the flags, running after `EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity` (so only genuinely-distinct owners reach it) and before save, under the same `transaction` governance.

2. **Pipeline wiring** — inserted the `assignPossibleDuplicate` step into `officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` between the hard-duplicate check and `assignCustomerCode`.

3. **Owner entity** (`Owner.java`) — added `possibleDuplicate` (Boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (Integer) columns with getters/setters.

4. **DB schemas** — added `possible_duplicate` and `possible_duplicate_of` columns to all four schemas (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres).

5. **OpenAPI spec** (`openapi.yml`) — added the two read-only fields to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes them and MapStruct auto-maps them by name (surfaced on `GET /api/owners/{id}`).

The design follows the project's established conventions (one small function class, `@Val` entity mutation, `Out`/`@Val` state flow, transactional governance, and the `Assign<X>` naming used by the sibling create-pipeline steps).
